exposure: Gestational age (early pregnancy: 6-24 weeks vs. term)
outcome: Placental nutrient transporter activity (amino acid, glucose, fatty acid transporters)
cohort: Placentas were collected from normal BMI and obese women at 6-24 weeks of gestation, and from normal BMI women at term.
finding: No significant differences were observed in placental nutrient transporter protein expression between normal BMI and obese women in early pregnancy, but several MVM and BM nutrient transporter expressions and activities were found to change significantly across gestation.
